blocks.text: Release overview

macOS Catalina 10.15 became publicly available on October 7, 2019. It split iTunes into Music, Podcasts, and TV apps; introduced Sidecar, Voice Control, Screen Time, Apple Arcade on Mac, Mac Catalyst, Find My, and stronger system and data protections.
Evidence boundary

The consumer feature record comes from Apple's launch announcement, developer compatibility details come from the 10.15 SDK notes, and vulnerability repairs come from the version-specific advisory. Later Catalina point-release changes and beta-only known issues are not projected onto 10.15.
Release overview
watchOS 5.1.3 was released on January 22, 2019. Apple's consumer history characterizes it as improvements and bug fixes, while the accompanying advisory documents concrete security repairs.
Evidence boundary

Apple did not enumerate an individual consumer feature for this point release. The article therefore preserves that limited description and records only the security areas explicitly listed in Apple's advisory.
Release overview

watchOS 5.2 was released on March 27, 2019 with ECG and irregular-rhythm notification expansion in Hong Kong and parts of Europe, second-generation AirPods support, real-time text calling, and security repairs.
Evidence boundary
Health-feature availability remained region- and device-dependent. This record names the regions exactly at the level Apple documented and does not treat later market expansions as part of 5.2.
Release overview
watchOS 5.2.1 was released on May 13, 2019 with additional ECG and irregular-rhythm markets, a Pride face, an Explorer face fix, insecure Bluetooth accessory restrictions, and security repairs.
Evidence boundary

The health additions applied only in the five countries listed by Apple and on compatible hardware. The Bluetooth statement is recorded as a security compatibility change, without guessing which individual accessories were affected.
Release overview

watchOS 6.0 launched on September 19, 2019 with Cycle Tracking, Noise, Voice Memos, Audiobooks, a watch-native App Store, Activity trends, new workouts and faces, richer Siri results, and more independent system apps.
Evidence boundary
Apple's notes mark some capabilities as model- or region-dependent; those constraints remain part of the record. Features introduced by later watchOS 6 point releases are excluded.
Release overview
watchOS 6.1 was released on October 29, 2019. It added AirPods Pro support, extended watchOS 6 to Apple Watch Series 1 and Series 2, and included improvements, bug fixes, and security repairs.
Evidence boundary
The hardware-compatibility expansion is specific to watchOS 6 availability on earlier watch models; it does not imply that every watchOS 6 feature worked on every model.
Release overview
watchOS 6.1.1 was released on December 10, 2019 as an explicitly security-focused point release. Apple's advisory supplies the concrete affected components and impact classes.
Evidence boundary
Apple did not publish a separate consumer feature list for 6.1.1. This page therefore records the security work without inventing unrelated performance or feature claims.
Release overview
tvOS 12.1.2 was released on January 22, 2019. Apple's consumer history describes general performance and stability improvements, while its security advisory provides the detailed technical record.
Evidence boundary
Because Apple did not name an individual consumer feature, this article does not infer one. The structured record separates the documented maintenance statement from the documented security fixes.
Release overview
tvOS 12.2 was released on March 25, 2019 with Siri playback requests from iPhone and iPad, Lock Screen access to Apple TV Remote controls on iOS 12.2, maintenance work, and security repairs.
Evidence boundary
Siri availability varied by region, and Lock Screen remote access depended on iOS 12.2. Those dependencies are retained instead of presenting the features as universal Apple TV behavior.
Release overview
tvOS 12.3 was released on May 13, 2019 with a redesigned Apple TV app that unified viewing, channels, store access, and recommendations, plus performance, stability, and security work.
Evidence boundary

Apple noted that the TV app and its individual features were not available in every country or region. The article describes the documented product design without assuming universal service availability.
Release overview

tvOS 13.0 launched on September 24, 2019 with a full-screen previewing Home screen, multiuser profiles and Control Center, Apple Arcade, broader game-controller support, timed Apple Music lyrics, new underwater screen savers, and security repairs.
Evidence boundary

The existing 13.0 route maps to Apple's tvOS 13 launch section. Apple Arcade and other services remained subject to regional availability, and later tvOS 13 maintenance changes are not folded into this event.
Release overview
tvOS 13.2 was released on October 28, 2019. Apple's consumer history lists general performance and stability improvements, while its advisory documents the release's security work.
Evidence boundary

No individual consumer feature is named in Apple's 13.2 section. This page retains that evidence boundary and does not convert security-advisory component names into unsupported user-facing feature claims.
Release overview
tvOS 13.3 was released on December 10, 2019. Apple's consumer history records general performance and stability improvements, supplemented by a version-specific security advisory.
Evidence boundary
Apple did not enumerate a new consumer feature for 13.3. The article therefore records only the documented maintenance classification and the separately documented security areas.

blocks.text: Public release

macOS Catalina 10.15 became publicly available on October 7, 2019. It split iTunes into Music, Podcasts, and TV apps; introduced Sidecar, Voice Control, Screen Time, Apple Arcade on Mac, Mac Catalyst, Find My, and stronger system and data protections.
What the evidence supports

The consumer feature record comes from Apple's launch announcement, developer compatibility details come from the 10.15 SDK notes, and vulnerability repairs come from the version-specific advisory. Later Catalina point-release changes and beta-only known issues are not projected onto 10.15.

changes.title: Music, Podcasts, and TV replace iTunes
changes.canonicalSummary: Separate Music, Podcasts, and TV apps replace iTunes as the primary Mac experiences for those media libraries and services.
changes.summary: Catalina divided iTunes' former media roles among dedicated Music, Podcasts, and TV apps while retaining access to existing libraries and store content.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

citations.locator: New Entertainment Apps: Apple Music, Apple Podcasts and Apple TV

changes.title: Sidecar extends the Mac desktop to iPad
changes.canonicalSummary: Sidecar can use a compatible iPad as a second Mac display or as Apple Pencil input for supported Mac apps.
changes.summary: The new Sidecar workflow extended or mirrored a Mac workspace on iPad over wired or wireless connections and supported tablet-style Pencil input.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

citations.locator: Sidecar: Expand Mac Workspace and Creativity with iPad

changes.title: System-wide Voice Control
changes.canonicalSummary: Voice Control provides on-device speech transcription, editing, and interface navigation across macOS.
changes.summary: Catalina added a voice-driven accessibility system with numbered and gridded controls for navigating apps and editing text without conventional input hardware.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

citations.locator: Accessibility: Empowering Everyone to Get the Most from Their Mac

changes.title: Mac Catalyst app framework
changes.canonicalSummary: Mac Catalyst lets developers adapt an iPad app into a native Mac app using shared technologies and project resources.
changes.summary: Catalina and Xcode 11 introduced the public Mac Catalyst path for bringing compatible iPad app code and interfaces to macOS.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

citations.locator: Mac Catalyst: Even More Great Apps on Mac

changes.title: Screen Time arrives on Mac
changes.canonicalSummary: Screen Time reports app and website activity and supports Downtime, App Limits, and family controls synchronized through iCloud.
changes.summary: The release brought device-use reporting and configurable limits to Mac, including cross-device settings and parental visibility through Family Sharing.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

citations.locator: Screen Time: Monitor Mac Activity For The Entire Family

changes.title: Apple Arcade on Mac
changes.canonicalSummary: The Mac App Store gains an Arcade section for downloading and playing games included with an Apple Arcade subscription.
changes.summary: Catalina added Apple Arcade's subscription catalog to Mac with cross-device game progress and support for common keyboard, mouse, and controller inputs.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

citations.locator: Apple Arcade: Now on Mac App Store

changes.title: Combined Find My app and offline finding
changes.canonicalSummary: Find My combines device and friend location and can help locate a supported sleeping, offline Mac through nearby Apple devices.
changes.summary: Catalina consolidated Apple's location tools and added privacy-preserving Bluetooth-assisted discovery for a missing compatible Mac that was not online.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

citations.locator: Additional Features in macOS Catalina — Find My

changes.title: Read-only system volume
changes.canonicalSummary: macOS system files run from a dedicated read-only volume separated from writable user data.
changes.summary: Catalina separated protected operating-system content from user data on a read-only system volume to reduce unintended or malicious modification.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

citations.locator: Security and Privacy: More User Control Than Ever

changes.title: Expanded app data permissions
changes.canonicalSummary: Apps must obtain permission before accessing additional categories of user documents and other protected data.
changes.summary: The release broadened consent controls around access to user files and paired them with stronger Gatekeeper checks of downloaded software.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

citations.locator: Security and Privacy: More User Control Than Ever

changes.title: 32-bit app execution removed
changes.canonicalSummary: Apps that execute i386 code no longer run on macOS 10.15, and remaining 32-bit compatibility stubs are nonfunctional.
changes.summary: Catalina completed the transition away from 32-bit Mac app execution, requiring applications and embedded executable code to support 64-bit architectures.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

changes.title: Network Kernel Extension API deprecated
changes.canonicalSummary: The legacy Network Kernel Extension API is deprecated in favor of supported modern networking extension technologies.
changes.summary: Apple marked the Network Kernel Extension API as deprecated, signaling developers to move network-system integrations to newer extension models.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

changes.title: macOS Catalina 10.15 security repairs
changes.canonicalSummary: The launch repaired vulnerabilities across graphics and media parsing, networking and printing, privilege boundaries, the kernel, WebKit, and other system components.
changes.summary: The launch repaired vulnerabilities across graphics and media parsing, networking and printing, privilege boundaries, the kernel, WebKit, and other system components.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

blocks.text: Public release

watchOS 6.0 launched on September 19, 2019 with Cycle Tracking, Noise, Voice Memos, Audiobooks, a watch-native App Store, Activity trends, new workouts and faces, richer Siri results, and more independent system apps.
What the evidence supports
Apple's notes mark some capabilities as model- or region-dependent; those constraints remain part of the record. Features introduced by later watchOS 6 point releases are excluded.

changes.title: Cycle Tracking app
changes.canonicalSummary: Cycle Tracking records menstrual-cycle information and can provide period and fertile-window predictions and notifications.
changes.summary: watchOS 6 added on-watch cycle logging for flow, symptoms, spotting, and optional fertility metrics, with prediction and notification tools.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

changes.title: Noise app and exposure notifications
changes.canonicalSummary: The Noise app measures environmental sound levels and can warn when sustained exposure may affect hearing.
changes.summary: Supported watches gained live decibel readings and configurable notifications for environmental sound levels that could pose a long-term hearing risk.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

changes.title: Voice Memos on Apple Watch
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple Watch can record, play, rename, and synchronize voice memos through iCloud.

changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

changes.title: Audiobooks app

changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

changes.title: App Store on Apple Watch

changes.title: Long-term Activity trends

changes.verificationMethod: Matched Apple's version-labeled consumer, developer, or security documentation to the existing audited public-release event.

changes.title: Workout elevation and persistent Stopwatch

changes.title: New faces, chimes, and complications

blocks.text: Public release

The existing 13.0 route maps to Apple's tvOS 13 launch section. Apple Arcade and other services remained subject to regional availability, and later tvOS 13 maintenance changes are not folded into this event.
